item.text: The failure is behavioral, not an environment error: the scheduler lets the shorter second task finish before the first, so tasks are running concurrently instead of sequentially. I’m reading the implementation and test to find the intended contract.

The implementation is using `Promise.all(tasks.map(...))`, which eagerly starts every task. I’m changing it to await each task in order while preserving the result array order and normal rejection behavior.
The code change is in place. I’m rerunning the same command, `npm test`, to verify the repaired behavior exactly against the benchmark check.
